(1) product-reads.ts (the Largo tool surface) already discloses this explicitly: `committed_count_note: "Score-floor-cleared candidates (pre-entry + open) -- NOT a count of open positions. Use open_position_count for that."` with a SEPARATE `open_position_count` field.
